s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Tire
Remove Engine Under Cover NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 6 bolts and 7 clips, and remove the engine under cover No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and the engine under cover rear LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Drain CVT Fluid

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, remove the drain plug and gasket, and drain the fluid.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, tighten the drain plug with a new gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Set the SST aligned with the groove of the front drive shaft assembly LH, and using a hammer, unstake the front axle hub nut LH.

item.ptxt: Set SST in the groove with its flat surface facing up.
Never grind the tip of SST with a grinder or similar tool.
When removing the front axle hub nut LH, completely unstake it.
Do not damage the threads of the front drive shaft assembly LH.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), remove the front axle hub nut LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Axle Shaft Nut RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Speed Sensor Front LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the speed sensor wire and flexible hose.
Remove the bolt and disconnect the speed sensor front LH from the steering knuckle.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow foreign matter to adhere to the tip and installation part of the speed sensor front LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Speed Sensor Front RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the cotter pin and castle nut.
Using SST, disconnect the tie rod end LH from the steering knuckle.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the front disc brake dust cover.
To prevent SST from falling, be sure to suspend it with a string or similar.
Do not damage the ball joint dust cover.
Do not damage the steering knuckle.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH and disconnect it from the front lower ball joint LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and disconnect the front stabilizer link assembly LH from the front shock absorber w/ coil spring.

atten4.ptxt: Using socket hexagon wrench 6, hold the stud bolt so that it does not spin.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Stabilizer Link Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the end of the front drive shaft assembly LH to disengage the front drive shaft assembly LH from the front axle assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: If the engagement is tight, tap the end of the front drive shaft assembly LH using a brass bar and hammer.

s2.ptxt: Push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle and pull the front drive shaft assembly LH out of the front axle assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Do not push the front axle assembly LH out farther than necessary.
Do not damage the front axle outboard joint boot.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.
Suspend the front drive shaft assembly LH with wire or similar.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the drive shaft assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not drop the drive shaft.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and drive shaft assembly RH from the bearing bracket.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not drop the drive shaft assembly.

atten4.ptxt: If the fit is tight, lightly tap the inboard joint assembly using a brass bar and hammer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove CVT Type T Oil Seal NO.1

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the oil seal No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove CVT Type T Oil Seal NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the oil seal No.2.
